story.iWant: settings saved safely to QSPI without corrupting data
story.soThat: power failures during save don't break the module
story.tasks: - Implement QSPI write with error detection and logging - Add rate-limiting to prevent excessive QSPI wear (max 1 write per 100ms) - Ensure writes only occur after bootloader completion - Handle write failures gracefully without crashing - Update settings struct before triggering save - Test write reliability across multiple power cycles

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - QSPI write failures detected and logged (via MIDI debug) - Writes only occur after bootloader completion (already ensured by Story 1.2) - Invalid settings detected on load (checksum or version mismatch) - Corrupted settings trigger recovery to safe defaults - Write operations are atomic (no partial writes) - Rate-limiting prevents excessive QSPI wear (max 1x/100ms) - No interference with bootloader during save operations

ideas.idea: Test 1: Toggle overdrive, verify settings saved within 100ms with no error messages
Test 2: Press button 50 times rapidly, verify QSPI writes throttled to ~1 per 100ms
Test 3: Simulate QSPI write failure, verify error logged and module continues operating
Test 4: Toggle overdrive 5 times, power off, power on, verify final state restored
Test 5: Power on/off 10 times rapidly, verify no corruption and bootloader still works
